l-e-e2-b07-02.title: Laba cunto fudud oo dhammaan afarta saaxiib cuni doonaan
l-e-e2-b07-02.topic: Cunto fudud ay dhammaantood jecel yihiin
l-e-e2-b07-02.goal: Doorashada laba cunto fudud oo xafladda ah, miisaan dhammaan shuruudaha is khilaafsan, dooro heshiiska ugu habboon, oo sharax sababta.
l-e-e2-b07-02.material: Waxaad iibsataa laba cunto fudud oo keliya. Ana: I like apples and cake. Ben: I like cake and grapes. Cho: I like apples. Dan: I like grapes. Shuruudaha: ① 2 nooc oo cunto fudud ② Mid kasta oo afarta ka mid ah wuxuu jecel yahay ugu yaraan hal cunto fudud.
l-e-e2-b07-02.s.s1.r.b: grapes, oo Dan ay jecel tahay, waa maqan yahay.
l-e-e2-b07-02.s.s1.r.c: apples, oo Cho ay jecel tahay, waa maqan yahay.
l-e-e2-b07-02.s.s1.r.d: Waa 3 nooc, sidaas darteed wuxuu jebiyaa shuruudda 2 nooc.
l-e-e2-b07-02.s.s1.explain: Ana iyo Cho waxay jecel yihiin apples, Ben iyo Dan-na waxay jecel yihiin grapes, sidaas darteed labada nooc waxay ku habboon yihiin dhammaan afarta.
l-e-e2-b07-02.s.s2.model.0: Haddii aad iibsato apples iyo grapes, dhammaan afarta waxay haystaan cunto fudud ay jecel yihiin, waa 2 nooc, sidaas darteed labada shuruudood waa la buuxiyey.
l-e-e2-b07-02.s.s2.model.1: Cho ayaa jecel apples oo keliya, Dan-na ayaa jecel grapes oo keliya, sidaas darteed labadan waa lagama maarmaan, kadibna wuxuu ku dhammaadaa 2 nooc.
